import json,subprocess
d=json.load(open('examples.json'))
for case in d:

    p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
    print(case['name'], p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:500])
    try:
        got=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except Exception as e:
        print('bad json', e, p.stdout[:200]); continue
    exp=case['output']
    print('MATCH' if got==exp else 'DIFF')
    if got!=exp:
        print('got ', json.dumps(got)[:1500])
        print('exp ', json.dumps(exp)[:1500])
EOF
